eval_script.py loads test_auctions.json, invokes /home/workspace/auction_bidding.py --backtest once against the full 2025 auction cycle, parses bidding_results.json, per-auction recomputes bidToCover/tail/indirect-share/allocation/reference-dislocation, calls score.py per auction, aggregates with cross-product-mix stability lane and rate-regime-shift bonus, emits TOTAL_SCORE <N> on stdout.

bidding_results.json is generated by the submitted auction_bidding.py at judge time, so it is not listed as a required submission file.
true_rate_regime_events.json is a hidden scoring label file used only for the +10 rate-regime-shift bonus lane.
